Hi again.

On Fri, Nov 30, 2012 at 12:44 PM, Sam Danziger <sam.da...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I've been trying to use FIRMA analysis
> (http://www.aroma-project.org/vignettes/FIRMA-HumanExonArrayAnalysis) on my
> mouse arrays (
> Mouse Exon 1.0 ST Array -
> http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/MoEx-1_0-st-v1).
>
> It looks like the scripts have completed successfully, but I have a few
> questions:

[snip]

> 3) How can I update the .cdf files?
> I would like to use the brainarray .cdf files
> (http://brainarray.mbni.med.umich.edu/Brainarray/Database/CustomCDF/CDF_download.asp)
> because they are regularly updated. However, (based on the results of the
> FIRMA run) their .cdf files do not have the correct exon/gene annotations.
> I can figure out which exons should be paired with which genes from annmap,
> but I cannot figure out how to store this information in the .cdf file.

Are you saying you wish to create a customize version of their custom
CDFs where you update the unit ("transcript") and unit group ("exon")
names?

/Henrik
